task.goal: Delete the following recipes from Broccoli app: Avocado Toast with Egg, Classic Margherita Pizza, Thai Peanut Noodle Salad.
task.final_summary: I deleted all three recipes from Broccoli: Avocado Toast with Egg, Classic Margherita Pizza, and Thai Peanut Noodle Salad. After each deletion the app confirmed it, and the recipe list now holds 29 recipes with none of the three remaining.

steps.note: Read Broccoli skill guidance
Observe current screen, launch Broccoli if needed
Launch Broccoli app and view recipe list
Map the recipe list to find the three target recipes
Search for Avocado Toast with Egg
Type search query for Avocado Toast with Egg
Open Avocado Toast with Egg recipe
Open More options menu on Avocado Toast with Egg to find Delete
Tap Delete for Avocado Toast with Egg
Confirm delete, then search for Classic Margherita Pizza
Search for Classic Margherita Pizza
Open Classic Margherita Pizza and delete it
Tap More options on Classic Margherita Pizza
Tap Delete menu item for Classic Margherita Pizza
Confirm delete, then search for Thai Peanut Noodle Salad
Search and delete Thai Peanut Noodle Salad
Close search and recount list with map_app levels 1
Recount full list with map_app levels 1 to confirm 29 recipes and no targets
Close keyboard, then map_app levels 1 to recount
Recount full list to confirm 29 recipes with no targets
Task complete
